name: Agify Name Age Estimate
description: A manual Agify lookup that presents an age estimate with its evidence count—not a certainty.
template:
<Stack gap="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" gap="xs">
    <Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
      <Text fw={700} truncate>Agify age estimate</Text>
      <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">A population-based estimate, not a certainty</Text>
    </Stack>
  </Group>
  <TextInput bind="name" label="Full name" placeholder="e.g. Alex Morgan" />
  <TextInput bind="country" label="Country code (optional)" placeholder="US" description="Two letters, such as US or FR" maxLength={2} />
  {(inputs.name ?? "").trim().length === 0 ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Enter a full name to run an estimate.</Text> : <SubFetch requestId="predict" trigger="manual" params={{ name: (inputs.name ?? "").trim(), country: /^[A-Za-z]{2}$/.test((inputs.country ?? "").trim()) ? (inputs.country ?? "").trim().toUpperCase() : undefined }} triggerContent={<Text fw={600}>Estimate age</Text>} triggerAriaLabel="Estimate age">{(result) => result.age == null ? <Stack gap="xs"><Text size="sm" fw={600}>{result.name ?? (inputs.name ?? "").trim()}</Text><Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No age estimate is available for this name.</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Evidence: {result.count == null ? "Unknown" : result.count.toLocaleString("en-US")} records.</Text>{result.country_id ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Country: {result.country_id}</Text> : null}</Stack> : <Stack gap="xs"><Group align="baseline" gap="xs" wrap="nowrap"><Text fz={30} fw={700} c="blue">{result.age.toLocaleString("en-US")} years</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">estimated</Text></Group><Text size="sm" fw={600} truncate>{result.name ?? (inputs.name ?? "").trim()}</Text><Text size="sm">Evidence: <Text span fw={600}>{result.count == null ? "Unknown" : result.count.toLocaleString("en-US")}</Text> records</Text>{result.country_id ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Country: {result.country_id}</Text> : null}<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Based on past records; not a reliable statement about an individual.</Text></Stack>}</SubFetch>}
</Stack>
